texts: Translocating the PA posteriorly is not part of the arterial switch: A.
In the Lecompte maneuver the pulmonary bifurcation is brought anterior to the aorta, so the reconstructed pulmonary artery lies in front without tension.
The coronary arteries are moved to the neoaorta (the old pulmonary root) and the distal aorta is joined to it.
The old aortic root is patched with autologous pericardium to become the neopulmonary root, and a VSD is closed, usually through the right atrium.
In the picture, the vampire sets the money pipe down in front of the orca, never behind.
Memory hook: the vampire always sets the pipe in front.
